title: Endpoint security trace event state
description: Shape of the `state` field for endpoint-security-design trace events.

defaultStance.description: What happens to a request no rule matches.

trustsIdentityHeaders.description: Whether the API takes the caller's identity from X-User-* headers.

trustsUnverifiedTokens.description: Whether the API decodes tokens without verifying the signature.

rateLimit.description: Requests allowed per client; 0 when no limit is installed.

rules.description: The ordered rule list; the first entry that matches decides.

method.description: HTTP method the rule is limited to, or 'ANY'.

pattern.description: Path pattern: an exact path or a prefix ending in /**.

requirement.description: The base requirement of the rule.

role.description: Role demanded by a hasRole rule; null otherwise.

scopes.description: Token scopes the rule additionally demands.

ownerOnly.description: Whether the rule also demands an object-level ownership check.

shadowed.description: Whether an earlier rule already matches these paths, making this one unreachable.

matched.description: Whether this rule is the one that matched the current request.

request.description: The request being processed (absent before the first one).

credential.description: The credential presented, e.g. 'Bearer alice' or 'none'.

headers.description: Request headers as the caller set them.

clientControlled.description: Whether this is an identity header any client could have typed.

principal.description: Who the API decided the caller is; null while nobody has been identified.

roles.description: Roles claimed for the caller — what the user may do.

scopes.description: Scopes of the presented token — what this token may do.

source.description: Where the identity came from; 'header' is never trustworthy.

gates.description: The chain, in execution order, with the verdict of each gate for the current request.

status.description: pending = never reached; breach = it let through what it should have stopped.

detail.description: Bare token behind the verdict: the matched pattern, the subject, a role, a scope or a counter.

outcome.description: How the current request ended (absent before the first one).

status.description: HTTP status the API answered with; null while the request is still in the chain.

decision.description: breach = the handler ran and should not have.

reason.description: Technical code for the refusal; null when nothing was refused.

detail.description: The offending role, scope, issuer, audience or owner; empty when not applicable.

stats.description: Running totals across the whole run.

insecure.description: Requests refused for arriving over plain http.

leakedCredentials.description: Credentials that were readable on the wire before being refused.

breaches.description: Requests served that should not have been.
